posts.text:
Time and time again, survivors were denied justice because their government refused to listen.

We're demanding that Chairman Comer video record Pam Bondi's deposition in a few weeks and release it to the public. The survivors deserve better transparency.

Video

This morning, @OversightDems are in Palm Beach, Florida, where so many of Epstein’s crimes took place. For the first time we will hear testimony from survivors in a hearing format. It’s time for justice and truth. Let’s end this White House cover-up.

Tomorrow, Epstein survivors will join us in Palm Beach to give their testimony to the Oversight Committee in a hearing format for the first time. It’s time to get to the truth — we’re not going to stop fighting for justice until we get it.

Video

The current attacks on voting rights and representation by the Supreme Court and conservative governors are going to cause enormous harm to Black representation in Congress and beyond.

The extreme right is dismantling decades of progress, and we should all unite and fight back.

Some of the worst ICE and DHS abuses that are happening in this country are happening in the state of Florida.

I joined @RepMaxwellFrost and @OversightDems in Orlando to hear directly from folks on the ground. Their stories should outrage every single American.

Video

Oversight Dems are in Orlando today led by @RepMaxwellFrost as we meet with immigration and civil rights leaders on the ground. 

The harm happening by ICE and DHS across the country is horrific. We intend to hold those responsible accountable.


Oversight Dems (@OversightDems)

Today, alongside @RepMaxwellFrost, Oversight Dems are in Orlando to highlight how Trump’s DHS is harming communities. We will make a visit to one of the local jails to meet with detainees impacted by Trump’s cruel mass d

Got a chance to stop by St. Anthony High School, which was the first place I worked at right out of college! Thanks to the St. Anthony community for welcoming me back and for the opportunity to speak to some of their graduating seniors.

Cudahy and Bell Gardens are getting more funds to help make their parks even better for families, teens and kids. I’m proud to deliver these resources to reinvest in our communities.

Video

So great to meet our future leaders from Alvarado Elementary in Signal Hill, where I also toured their newly-renovated City Hall.

Signal Hill has a great community, schools and families. Thank you to these great kids for the warm welcome.

Why is Chairman Comer refusing to videotape Pam Bondi's interview and release it to the public?

This was the AG who was at the center of the White House Epstein cover-up. The American people deserve transparency.

Video

Gas back home here in California is over $6 a gallon in some communities. And people can’t afford the rent or their groceries. 

And yet the President is focused on a ballroom and a war that’s costing us over $1 billion a day. It was never America First for him.
Release the Epstein files! And Bondi must testify! #congressman #dems #epstein #pambondi
We just filed for re-election to Congress!
Abolish ICE. #congressman #democrats #dems #abolishice
It’s a White House Cover-Up. #democrats #congressman #dems #oversightcommittee #releasethefiles
ICE is terrorizing LA. All people have a right to due process. #democrats #congressman #dems
NO MORE OIL DRILLING off our coast. #democrats #congressman #dems
We won’t stop until we RELEASE the Epstein files! #democrats #congressman
Time to stop this Epstein cover-up.
Release the Epstein Files, NOW. #democrats #congressman #dems
Let’s fucking go.
